items.name: Total company orders and backlog, Q2 2026 (post-Thermon)
items.claim: CECO Environmental reported orders of $798.5 million (up 191 percent) and backlog of $1,819.1 million (up 164 percent) for the quarter, its first quarter as a combined company following its acquisition of Thermon (see notes for the acquisition close date).
items.source_excerpt: Orders of $798.5 million, up 191 percent; backlog of $1,819.1 million, up 164 percent

notes: Q2 2026 8-K earnings release is the only stored evidence for CECO Environmental. It carries the largest single backlog figure of the seven issuers, though the release attributes the jump primarily to the Thermon acquisition rather than organic minor-NSR-linked demand and the company's backlog concentrates in large-scale power generation projects generally, not emissions-aftertreatment specifically.
